notes.title: Boss Of FCs Devblog #2 - Leagues and Transfers
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Development for Boss Of FCs is moving full speed ahead, and today we’re excited to share two major updates that will bring the game even closer to a true football season experience: automatic match simulation and a fully functional transfer screen!

[h3][b]⏳ Time Moves On — And So Does the League![/b][/h3]
From now on, when you advance time, it’s not just your own club waiting for the next matchday — every team in the league will have their fixtures automatically simulated in the background.

The league will progress naturally as matches are played and results are reflected on the table in real-time. You’ll need to keep an eye on your rivals, as the competition never stands still!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505686/2eb9db469096b542d5f4158cd007671e096f0fd1.gif[/img]


[h3][b]💼 Transfer Screen: Shape Your Squad![/b][/h3]

The transfer screen is now active! You can select which club you want to manage transfers for and make moves as you see fit.

Scout new stars for your own team, monitor rival clubs’ lineups, or shake up the entire transfer market — the choice is yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505686/c6585e65e5dbf22a798a1efb22702f2dc16cba0a.gif[/img]


[h3][b]📜 Match History: Keep Track of Every Result![/b][/h3]

A football season isn’t just about the next match — it’s about the journey. Now, all past match results are saved and accessible.

You can check which teams played each other, analyze form trends, and relive the surprises and key moments of the season anytime you want.

Boss Of FCs keeps evolving into a more dynamic and realistic football management experience with every new update. We're excited to share these features with you — and there's much more to come!

See you in the next devlog!

notes.title: Boss Of FCs Devblog #1 - 101
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to the first devblog of our game, Boss Of FCs!

From time to time, we want to keep you updated on the latest developments of our game with these kinds of updates.

I’d like to talk a bit about what we’ve done so far and what our short-term goals are.


[h2][b]DEVELOPMENTS SO FAR[/b][/h2]

Boss Of FCs has been in development for about a month, and we've made significant progress in creating the game’s content. Apart from a few minor UI bugs, the visuals we’ve shared on our Steam page are largely representative of how the UI will look.

As you can see below, here’s a "Work in Progress" screen of a player that is still under development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505686/3dcaf3e849e3e1da25e1991f408642b4a92bec94.jpg[/img]

At the same time, we have started establishing connections between different pages and integrating the "dummy" data used in UI development into the game. Since 95% of the UI design has already been planned, one of our priorities is to quickly complete this stage and shift some focus to back-end development.

Of course, these are not the only developments we’ve made, but since we’ve shared the most crucial aspects of the UI, we don’t want to overwhelm you with too many details. UI visuals and the GUI Pack may change, but we can say that we will stick to this UI template in terms of overall design.


[h2][b]SHORT-TERM GOALS[/b][/h2]

Our goal is to create playable content as soon as possible and move into the testing phase. The entire team is working with great dedication to achieve this. Over the next month, we aim to make visible progress (while also keeping you updated at regular intervals).

We are excited about our game and can't wait to share that excitement with you!

Soon, we’ll be sharing our community urls here so we can stay connected!

Stay tuned!

Best regards,
Altair Games
